title: Ameesha Patel Says She Will Never Marry, Opens Up on Choosing Career Over Love
excerpt: The Gadar actress, now 51, has doubled down on her decision to stay single, telling an X user she 'can't afford a man' disrupting her independence.
body:
• Bollywood actress Ameesha Patel, 51, has declared she will never marry, shifting from her earlier stance of being open to the idea
  • In a viral X exchange, Patel responded to a user's question about her marital status with a blunt reply about not being able to 'afford' a man interfering with her life
  • The Kaho Naa Pyaar Hai star says she chose her career over a serious relationship before entering Bollywood

Bollywood actress Ameesha Patel has declared she will never marry, marking a sharper stance from the star who previously said she was open to the idea if she found someone worthy. The 51-year-old, best known for her roles in Kaho Naa Pyaar Hai and the Gadar franchise, made the comments in a recent exchange on X that quickly went viral.

From Open to Never

When an X user asked Patel why she had never married, the actress responded with characteristic directness, saying she could not afford to let a man come in and disrupt the independence she has built over decades. The reply left fans and commentators buzzing, with India TV News describing it as a "savage" response that "stunned" followers.

The declaration represents an evolution from her position during a 2025 appearance on Ranveer Allahbadia's podcast, where she said she was "all up for" marriage as long as she found someone worthy. At 51, Patel appears to have settled the question definitively.

"I have given up both things for the other, and I think that I have learnt from both." — Ameesha Patel The actress has also spoken about the double standards she faces."

A Career Built on Independence

Patel has long been candid about the tradeoffs between her personal life and her career. In multiple interviews, she has described a serious pre-Bollywood relationship with a man from a prominent South Bombay industrial family that ended because he did not want a partner in the public eye.

"People who love you will let your career prosper. I have lost a lot for my career, and I have also lost a lot for love. I have given up both things for the other, and I think that I have learnt from both."

— Ameesha Patel

The actress has also spoken about the double standards she faces. She continues to receive marriage proposals from men half her age and from affluent families, but has consistently prioritized mental maturity and financial independence in any potential partner.

"I have met a lot of people older than me who have the IQ of a fly," Patel quipped during the podcast interview.

Career Highlights and What's Next

Patel burst onto the Bollywood scene with Kaho Naa Pyaar Hai in 2000, followed by the blockbuster Gadar: Ek Prem Katha in 2001. She reprised her role as Sakina in Gadar 2 in 2023, which became one of the year's highest-grossing Hindi films. She also appeared on Bigg Boss 13 as a guest.

Her comments have sparked a broader conversation on social media about marriage expectations for women in the Indian entertainment industry, where actresses have historically faced scrutiny for remaining unmarried past a certain age. For Patel, the answer is simple: her career and her freedom come first.
nri_angle: Patel's candid stance on marriage resonates with diaspora women navigating similar cultural pressures around relationships and independence, challenging traditional expectations within Indian communities abroad.
